get_list_entry_field.title: Get a list entry field value
get_list_entry_field.description: Read one field value (a single cell) on a list entry, with its type and data.

update_list_entry_field.title: Update a list entry field value
update_list_entry_field.description: Set one cell on a list entry. value is typed: {type: text, data: "..."}, {type: number, data: 3}, {type: datetime, data: ISO date}, {type: dropdown, data: {dropdownOptionId}}, {type: ranked-dropdown, data: {dropdownOptionId}}, {type: person, data: {id}}, {type: company, data: {id}}, {type: location, data: {...}} or their -multi forms with lists; data null clears it.

value.description: The typed value, {type, data}: type is text, filterable-text, number, datetime, dropdown, ranked-dropdown, person, company, location or a -multi form; data is the string, number, ISO datetime, {dropdownOptionId}, {id} or location object (a list for -multi), or null to clear.

update_list_entry_fields.title: Update several list entry field values
update_list_entry_fields.description: Set up to 100 cells on one list entry in a single request -- the same as calling update_list_entry_field for each.

updates.description: Updates, each {id: field id, value: {type, data}} as for update_list_entry_field.

merge_companies.title: Merge two companies
merge_companies.description: Merge a duplicate company into a primary one. Everything on the duplicate moves to the primary, then the duplicate is deleted -- this cannot be undone. Runs asynchronously; track it with get_company_merge. BETA.

duplicate_company_id.description: The ID of the company profile that will be merged and then deleted. All data from this company will be transferred to the primary company.

primary_company_id.description: The ID of the company profile that will be kept after the merge. All data from the duplicate company will be merged into this company.

output.description: The merge, with its id and task url.
